archetypes.name: AC mains input and protection
archetypes.description: Mains entry section: connector, fuse, inrush limiter, MOV, EMI filter, and the rectifier feeding downstream stages.
critical_electrical_constraints: Creepage/clearance per IEC 60664-1 for the mains working voltage, PD2, material group
Fuse first after the connector; MOV after the fuse
Bulk capacitor voltage rating >= 400 V for universal input
Every mains net declared in voltage_rails (fail-closed)
verification_requirements: Every mains and HV net declared in voltage_rails (unknown voltage blocks clearance derivation)
Creepage/clearance table per net pair recorded in the design profile
Isolation barrier verified as a keep-out on all layers
Dielectric strength (hipot) test plan recorded; this is a hardware-validation item, not an offline check
unsupported_conditions: Any mains net without a declared voltage
Logic ground within creepage distance of mains copper
Mains traces at signal widths

maturity.evidence: rule set evaluated against synthetic fixtures in tests/test_cross_domain_cases.py
